title: Ro reviews: is Ro legit , what customers say, and who treats you
summary: Ro reviews and whether Ro is legit: Nov 2026 BBB ratings, how Ro's plans and clinicians work, and how a $40 FutureClinic doctor visit compares.
body_markdown:
At Ro, a US-licensed doctor or nurse practitioner at a Ro-affiliated physician practice reviews your online visit, and medicine ships on an auto-refill plan.[Founded in 2017](https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/telemedicine/ro-0121-173581) (the company behind it is[Roman Health Ventures Inc.](https://ro.co/terms-of-use/) ), Ro holds an A+ BBB grade and a[1.1-out-of-5 average across 352 BBB reviews](https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/telemedicine/ro-0121-173581/customer-reviews) (November 2026). For a physician of your own, a FutureClinic doctor treats you by message with no subscription required.


## Is Ro a legitimate company, and who treats you there?


Yes, Ro is a legitimate US telehealth company[founded in 2017](https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/telemedicine/ro-0121-173581) (the company behind it is[Roman Health Ventures Inc.](https://ro.co/terms-of-use/) ) by[Zachariah Reitano, Saman Rahmanian and Rob Schutz](https://ro.co/founder-letter/) , listing "3,000,000+ members" on[ro.co](https://ro.co/) (November 2026). Per[Ro's terms](https://ro.co/terms-of-use/) , Ro "does not provide any medical services":[Ro's telehealth FAQ](https://ro.co/faq/telehealth/) says US-licensed "doctors and nurse practitioners" at a Ro-affiliated practice treat you, with licenses in chat. Ro's pages refer to "your provider" but don't say whether you can choose or keep a specific clinician. Ro says its own pharmacy,[Roman Health Pharmacy](https://ro.co/rhp/) , is NABP-accredited. Ro serves[adults 18 and over (21 and over for some services)](https://ro.co/terms-of-use/) in[all 50 states and D.C., though availability varies by state, and you need to have seen a clinician within the last three years](https://ro.co/faq/telehealth/) .


## What do Ro reviews and BBB complaints say?


As of November 2026, Ro pairs an A+[BBB grade](https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/telemedicine/ro-0121-173581) (accredited July 2018;[reviews don't affect the grade](https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/telemedicine/ro-0121-173581/more-info) ) with a[1.1-out-of-5 average from 352 BBB reviews](https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/telemedicine/ro-0121-173581/customer-reviews) .[Ro's ED page](https://ro.co/erectile-dysfunction/) notes testimonial patients got free treatment.


[Ro's BBB page](https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/telemedicine/ro-0121-173581) lists 771 complaints over three years (409 in the last 12 months); on[BBB's complaints page](https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/telemedicine/ro-0121-173581/complaints) , the largest groups, by BBB's count, are product issues (262), service issues (185) and billing (139), then sales and advertising (66) and orders (64). Ro answered all 771 (189 resolved, 582 answered). Recent[BBB complaints](https://www.bbb.org/us/ny/new-york/profile/telemedicine/ro-0121-173581/complaints) mostly concern Ro Body; Ro replies that membership and medicine are billed separately.


## What does Ro treat, and how does a visit work?


Ro treats ED, premature ejaculation, hair loss, acne, skin aging, weight, short lashes, cold sores and genital herpes via an online visit reviewed within 24 hours, plus supplements on[its pricing page](https://ro.co/pricing/) and[fertility tests](https://ro.co/fertility/) (November 2026). After the first visit,[Ro's telehealth FAQ](https://ro.co/faq/telehealth/) notes phone or video options, with free follow-up messaging on[Ro's sildenafil page](https://ro.co/erectile-dysfunction/sildenafil/) .


Alongside FDA-approved generics, Ro sells compounded products that, in Ro's words, are not FDA-approved: Ro Sparks, Daily Rise Gummies, Ro Mane Spray,[Hair Solution Rx](https://ro.co/womens-hair-loss/) and[Custom Rx skincare](https://ro.co/dermatology/) . The[FDA states](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/human-drug-compounding/compounding-and-fda-questions-and-answers) compounded drugs are not generics, and[the agency](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/guidance-compliance-regulatory-information/human-drug-compounding) does not review their safety, effectiveness or quality before they are marketed.


## How do Ro plans, auto-refills and refunds work?


Ro's plans auto-refill until turned off online, and[Ro's refunds page](https://ro.co/returns-and-refunds/) says all sales of prescription products are final, and asks you to contact Ro if you think your prescription was filled in error. Per[Ro's cost FAQ](https://ro.co/faq/cost-pricing-services/) , the visit is free "in most cases," and you're charged for the medicine only after a clinician approves a treatment plan. Hair loss ships quarterly only; Ro doesn't take insurance (except for[select Ro Body GLP-1 pens, where Ro checks your coverage](https://ro.co/weight-loss/pricing/) ), and doesn't accept HSA/FSA cards.


Ro's prices (November 10, 2026) start at $4 a dose for generic sildenafil ($32/month minimum),[generic tadalafil from $8 a dose taken daily (billed $240 a month)](https://ro.co/erectile-dysfunction/tadalafil/) , or from $11 a dose for 5 mg on[Ro's pricing page](https://ro.co/pricing/) (dosing minimums apply), $16 to $20 a month for finasteride (12-month to quarterly plan), and $29 a month for Custom Rx skincare. Because these are recurring plans, you stay subscribed to keep getting the medicine. At Cost Plus Drugs,[30 sildenafil 50 mg tablets](https://www.costplusdrugs.com/medications/sildenafilcitrate-50mg-tablet/) cost $6.36,[30 tadalafil 5 mg tablets](https://www.costplusdrugs.com/medications/tadalafil-5mg-tablet/) $5.97 (November 3, 2026), and[90 finasteride 1 mg tablets](https://www.costplusdrugs.com/medications/finasteride-1mg-tablet/) $7.47 (October 25, 2026) before shipping. Six months of finasteride is $108 on Ro's 6-month plan, or $54.94 before shipping for a $40 FutureClinic visit plus two 90-tablet fills if your doctor judges a six-month prescription safe, at the pharmacy you choose where insurance or a coupon may lower the price.


[Ro Body](https://ro.co/weight-loss/pricing/) is $39 the first month, then $74 to $149 a month (November 2026), with brand GLP-1s billed separately; see our[Ro vs FutureClinic weight loss comparison](https://futureclinic.com/blog/ro-vs-futureclinic-for-weight-loss-glp-1-cost-without-membership) .
